evidence: One historical benchmark/index check; all other portfolios, quotes, holidays, forecasts and transactions are synthetic.
scope: Research reference, not an institution-specific contract engine, empirical model, accounting policy or regulatory return.

benchmark.synthetic_calendar_note: 15 September is an invented holiday for this test, not an asserted Kenyan holiday.

curves.market_status: Synthetic unit-price annual coupon quotes; not Kenyan market observations

pricing.fee_yield_contract: Synthetic KES1m, 14% one-year bullet interest, KES10k upfront fee; other fees/costs absent. Cash-flow yield is not labelled statutory APR.

scenarios.scenario_label: Synthetic bank, KES millions; cash-flow timing and opening-balance interest explicitly assumed

separate_hedge_choice_case.objective_note: Dimensionless objective = sum((residual PV01 / 1000 currency-per-bp)^2) + 0.001 * cost / 1000 currency. Relative weights are illustrative policy choices, not universal economic utility.

operations.evidence: Synthetic deterministic demonstration; no empirical Kenyan claims
